title: Power iteration
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define its power iteration to be the result of applying the step function `powStep` exactly $1\cdot(|z|+1)^1$ times, starting from `powInit z`.
caveat: The definitions of `powStep` and `powInit` are not included, so their mathematical meanings cannot be stated more specifically.
